about.content: MKL-Fitout is a specialized interior fit-out and woodwork company based in the UAE. With our in-house joinery factory and skilled design and execution teams, we provide complete interior solutions tailored to both residential and commercial projects.

aboutPage.visionText: To be one of the UAE's leading interior and woodwork companies known for quality, reliability, and timeless design—transforming ordinary spaces into exceptional experiences.
aboutPage.missionText: Deliver complete interior solutions that exceed client expectations through precision, creativity, and in-house craftsmanship.

section1.title: 1. Agreement to Terms
section1.content: By accessing and using MKL-Fitout's services, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.

section2.title: 2. Services Description
section2.content: MKL-Fitout provides interior design, fit-out, custom woodwork, and renovation services for residential and commercial properties in the UAE. Our services include but are not limited to: custom joinery, kitchen design, bedroom fit-outs, bathroom renovations, office interiors, restaurant fit-outs, and 3D design visualization.

section3.title: 3. Project Terms and Conditions
section3.content: All projects require a detailed scope of work, timeline, and cost estimate. Changes to the approved design or scope may result in additional charges. Payment terms are specified in individual project contracts. MKL-Fitout reserves the right to retain ownership of design concepts until full payment is received.

section4.title: 4. Quality and Warranties
section4.content: We guarantee the quality of our workmanship for a period of 12 months from project completion. This warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship under normal use conditions. Normal wear and tear, misuse, or damage due to external factors are not covered.

section5.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
section5.content: MKL-Fitout's liability is limited to the contract value of the specific project. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid for our services.

section6.title: 6. Intellectual Property
section6.content: All design concepts, drawings, and intellectual property created by MKL-Fitout remain our property until full payment is received. Clients may not reproduce or distribute our designs without written permission.

section7.title: 7. Privacy and Data Protection
section7.content: We respect your privacy and handle personal information in accordance with UAE data protection laws. Client information is kept confidential and used solely for project execution and communication purposes.

section8.title: 8. Governing Law
section8.content: These terms are governed by UAE law. Any disputes shall be resolved through the appropriate courts in the Emirate of Ajman, UAE.

section1.title: 1. Information We Collect
section1.content: We collect personal information that you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, phone number, project details, and property information. We also collect technical information through website usage, including IP addresses and browser information.

section2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
section2.content: We use your information to: provide interior design and fit-out services, communicate about your project, send project updates and invoices, improve our services, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

section3.title: 3. Information Sharing
section3.content: We may share your information with: trusted contractors and suppliers working on your project, professional consultants (architects, engineers), payment processors, and legal authorities when required by law. All parties are bound by confidentiality agreements.

section4.title: 4. Data Security
section4.content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

section5.title: 5. Data Retention
section5.content: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services and comply with legal obligations. Project-related information is typically retained for 7 years after project completion for warranty and legal purposes.

section6.title: 6. Your Rights
section6.content: You have the right to: access your personal information, correct inaccurate information, request deletion of your information (subject to legal obligations), object to processing, and withdraw consent where applicable. Contact us to exercise these rights.

section7.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
section7.content: Our website uses cookies to improve user experience and analyze website traffic. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences. Some features may not function properly if cookies are disabled.

section8.title: 8. Contact Information
section8.content: For privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at: Email: info@mklfitout.ae, Phone: +971 50 970 0715, Address: Industrial Area, Ajman, UAE

section9.title: 9. Updates to This Policy
section9.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new policy on our website with an updated revision date.
